asked.item: Is the comment's age (older than 7 days) the cause of the failed status

verdict.reason: The help pages state the 7-day limit for private replies to a comment and that a message sent outside an allowed window reaches status failed, which covers this customer's question about the comment's age.

steps.text: A private reply to a comment can be sent only within 7 days of the comment.
A message sent outside an allowed window reaches status failed, so a comment older than 7 days is a likely cause of the failed status.
